title: ReturnReceipt
$comment: Signed by the recipient’s key alone; the sender funded it; the recipient pays nothing (§10.4, T-P1-8, T-P16-2). Binds one envelope and one postmark and cannot be re-worn (P-1). AUTHORED object (§5.1): produced by an actor and validated against this schema. STUB. Tracks §5 of WISHMAIL_SPEC_v0_5.md field for field. Not yet registered under HCS-13: spec/pins.json registeredSchemas is null for this object (T-P9-4, T-P9-9). The specification leads, the schema follows, the tests are the court: where a constraint below is not expressible in JSON Schema, the named test is what holds it.

keyEpoch.description: The epoch under which the envelope opened.

proof.description: uri: the manifest’s postmark on the recipient’s manifest topic (§10.4).

oneOf.description: A structured locator naming one HCS message (§5.2). Not an HRL: the HCS-1 HRL grammar names files, not messages.

ledgerTag.description: Ledger tag (§5.1). The core defines exactly these two and refuses every other; an extension that claims another ledger widens this enum (§16.7).
ledgerTag.$comment: T-P9-11 — an envelope whose AAD names an undefined ledger tag is rejected at send and appraises unbound at replay.

uri.description: The manifest’s canonical location. Null until `send` publishes the manifest (§6.2, §6.4 step 2).
